templates.title: Airwave
templates.name: airwave
templates.description: Turn your Plex library into custom, always-on live TV channels, watchable on native apps for every screen. Deploys the Airwave server, admin web, and a Postgres database.
templates.note: Set the Server URL and Admin Web URL to this host's IP (or domain) plus the published ports, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:36020 and http://192.168.1.10:36021 (not localhost). Optional fields map to the same variables as .env.example; leave them blank to use the compose defaults. After it starts, open the Admin web, sign in, and connect your Plex server. Docs: https://www.getairwave.tv/docs/self-hosting/docker

env.name: CG_IMAGE
env.label: Image (pin a version or use latest)

env.name: POSTGRES_DATA_VOLUME
env.label: (optional) Postgres data host path (blank = named volume)

env.name: WORKFLOW_ENABLED
env.label: (optional) AI lineup workflow engine: set to 1 to enable

env.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
env.label: (optional) TV web player: set to tvweb to enable

env.name: TV_SERVER_URL
env.label: (optional) Override the TV player's server URL

env.name: AIRWAVE_CLOUD_SERVICE_ENABLED
env.label: (optional) Airwave Cloud remote access: set to 1 to show it
